questions.title: Four in a Row, Grounded
questions.prompt: Nathan said organizing a roughly 2,500-message tournament got him grounded in ninth grade. What dangerous competitive activity had taken over the group chat?
options: Connect Four
Clash Royale
A spelling bee conducted entirely through voice messages
questions.explanation: A Connect Four tournament had become a 2,500-message domestic incident. The punishment was temporary; the competitive spirit survived.

receipts.text: I got grounded for a short time for having/organizing a 2500 ish message connect four tournament in the gc in 9th grade

questions.title: Premium Hydration Penalty
questions.prompt: In Nico's video-game-like chase dream, he reached a convenience store. What happened if he bought the fancy water instead of the bad water?
options: He had to restart the whole dream
The people chasing him got closer
The cashier became the final boss
questions.explanation: Bad water let the chase continue normally. Fancy water actively helped his pursuers. Even the dream's upgrade system was against him.

receipts.text: My dream was me and 2 other people I forgot who were being chased by these people in a video game like world and I was at a convenience store and if I bought the fancy water bottle the people chasing me would get closer but if I got the bad water bottle I could continue as normal

questions.title: The Olympic Scandal
questions.prompt: Ronan's workplace Olympics included ping-pong, walking relays and seating people with their assigned countries. What scandal occurred at his desk while he worked from home?
options: His team traded him for a printer cartridge
Someone entered his chair in the walking relay
Whoever sat there ate two of his Clif bars
questions.explanation: The international seating arrangement cost Ronan two Clif bars. He was not celebrating the spirit of the Games.

receipts.text: We are doing this olympics shit this week at work some of the events are work related and some are fun like walking relay or pingpong but yesterday when i was working from home they had the seating rearranged so people were sitting with their country/teams which are randomly selected. Anyway whoever was sitting at my desk ate 2 of my clif bars im pissed

questions.title: Liquidity Problem
questions.prompt: Charlie argued a free beer beat a free laptop. Nathan pointed out that a laptop could be sold for many beers. What was Charlie's decisive counterargument?
options: What if you want a beer right now?
The laptop might only run beer-making software on Windows
Selling it would technically make the beers no longer free
questions.explanation: A laptop can teach you how to make beer. That does not solve the immediate problem of wanting one. Charlie valued time to beer.

receipts.text: IMO a free beer would beat a free laptop
A free laptop can be sold for numerous free beers ☝🏼🤓
With a laptop you can search how to make beer, but what if you want a beer right now? That is why you go with the beer

questions.title: No Names, No Exclusion
questions.prompt: In Johannes' secret-artifact dream, an old woman with a shotgun blocked the group with a semi truck. How did the unnamed Noodle expedition escape?
options: Disguised themselves as the artifacts
Threw their car over a fence onto the highway
Convinced her that Dimitri owned the trucking company
questions.explanation: They worked together to throw the entire car over a fence. Johannes withheld the cast list to avoid exclusion allegations; Dimitri still demanded to have been there.

receipts.text: Had a dream where some of y’all, no names for the exclusion allegations, and I in the states. We were diggin up secret artifacts and this old woman with a shotgun blocked us off with a semi truck and we worked together to throw our car over a fence onto the highway to escape. Can’t wait for part 2 of this

questions.title: Almost Fully Automated

To manually type every order into the group chat
To be a face or security
questions.explanation: The restaurant could apparently run itself, except for needing a human face and possibly a bouncer. Jimmy immediately volunteered for the role.

receipts.text: We could just get an AI to do everything in the restaurant
one person has to be in there maybe just to be a face or security
I’ll do it, I’ll be like the happy mask salesman

questions.title: Minimum Passing Altitude
questions.prompt: Aidan passed his first pilot-ground-school PRACTICE exam with the minimum score. How did he say he'd spent about 45 minutes of the two-hour limit?
options: On TikTok or getting more alcohol
Building a flight simulator out of dining-room chairs
Arguing with the test bank about whether birds have right of way
questions.explanation: He said he was noticeably drunk, guessed some of the math questions, and still scraped a pass. This was his practice exam at home, not an actual flight.

receipts.text: Now that I’ve finished, I need to prepare for the written exam, which is half of what you need to pass to get your private pilots license.

I just took my first practice exam, noticeably drunk, in the dining room at my laptop, and passed on the first try (with the minimum score) despite spending about 45 minutes of the 2 hour time limit either on tik tok or getting more alcohol.
And guessing on like 8 questions and marking them bc I was too drunk to attempt the math they needed

questions.title: Clean Conscience, No Loot
questions.prompt: Nathan found a cool legendary in Fallout during 25 unsaved minutes, then said he chose a clean conscience over loot. What had gone wrong?
options: The legendary belonged to a child NPC
He accidentally killed his own settler and everyone turned on him
He discovered the weapon was a reward for joining the wrong faction
questions.explanation: He was fighting gunners outside his settlement and hit one of his own people. The entire settlement turned on him. Goodbye, legendary; hello, conscience.

receipts.text: Just played for 25 minutes without saving in fallout and got a cool legendary during that time but I was killing some gunners outside my main settlement and accidentally killed my own settler and everyone turned on me
I choose clean conscious over loot but what a pain in the ass

questions.title: Death by Pamphlet
questions.prompt: Jacky swatted a fly with a booklet, then hit it vertically after it fell. What did he discover while picking it up?
options: It was still carrying a crumb of his food
It had landed inside a picture of another fly
He'd decapitated it
questions.explanation: The second booklet strike had become a tiny guillotine. He only noticed during cleanup.

receipts.text: I slapped this fly buzzing in my room with a booklet and it fell on the ground injured and I then hit the fly with the booklet vertically and then when picking it up to throw away I realized I decapitated that mf
